profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ CNN | Fullstack Web Development
profile.summary: Creative and forward-thinking Software Developer able to create cutting edge websites and applications for high-profile clients with challenging demands and visions.

positions.title: Specialist
positions.description:
Reported maintenance and repair needs for transportation vehicles and equipment to lessen delays and cancellations by 35%.
Effectively communicated with pilots by clearly speaking, enunciating properly and actively listening.
Issued landing and takeoff instructions to pilots at the airport with approximately 12 daily flights.
Alerted airport response personnel to crisis situations, including incoming medical and other emergency landings
Monitored weather conditions, aircraft position reports, aeronautical information and navigational charts to evaluate flight progress
Proactively identified and solved complex problems impacting operations.
Led diverse training simulations to prepare teams for combat and emergency situations to reduce the simulated death count by 40%.

projects.title: JS Documentation Page
projects.description:
The JS Documentation page is a static HTML5 website styled with CSS made to be a beginners guide and quick reference to some of the more basic and fundamental parts of JavaScript.
Assembled a side navigation so users can scroll on the documentation page while the side nav stays in place and which creates a more user friendly approach.
Determined which screen sizes needed customized media queries to create a responsive website that can be viewed on all devices and different browsers.

projects.title: ReserveIt
projects.description:
ReserveIt is a FullStack MERN (Mongoose, Express, React, Node) app that allows users to create events and reserve a spot at an event they find interesting.
Conducted unit and user acceptance tests on React components and the backend API
Allow for user authentication to create events and RSVP to events that they are not currently attending.
Set up local storage to save user tokens created from the JsonWebToken module which then would send it off to the backend API using axios to check for authentication and authorization
Created a Redux store for a more maintainable state management with Auth,Event and Alert actions and reducers customized with Bootstrap and CSS to create a clean looking, mobile responsive and user friendly UI
